about: Saddle up for your weekly dose of Country music on triple j! We’re giving you the biggest country tracks in the world and shouting about the artists making noise in our own backyard

items.desc: It’s time to pay tribute to some big Aussie movers and shakers on Country Club this week. We’ll hear from Rachael Fahim, fresh from taking home the ARIA Award for Best Country Album and Wade Forster is riding high after making Golden Guitar history with an incredible 10 nominations across 9 categories. Available until 22 Dec. items.title: From ARIA winners to outback rodeos - Country Club's got it all!
